description: This file defines a request handler in a CQRS pattern for retrieving order details, implementing GetOrderDetailsHandler which handles GetOrderDetails requests and produces an OrderDetailViewModel.

classes.name: GetOrderDetailsHandler
classes.description: Handles fetching detailed order information for display, using repository pattern to load data with specifications.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the GetOrderDetails request to retrieve order data, constructs and returns an OrderDetailViewModel.
